description: This file defines the QhullPoints class and related iterators for managing arrays of QhullPoint objects, including constructors, accessors, and iterator classes, within the orgQhull namespace.

classes.name: QhullPoints
classes.description: Represents an array of QhullPoint objects with iterator support, providing methods for access, modification, and conversion.

classes.name: QhullPoints::iterator
classes.description: A random-access iterator for QhullPoints, allowing traversal and manipulation of points.

classes.name: QhullPoints::const_iterator
classes.description: A constant iterator for QhullPoints, providing read-only access.

classes.name: QhullPoints::PrintPoints
classes.description: A helper struct for printing QhullPoints with a message and optional identifier.

classes.name: QhullPointsIterator
classes.description: A Java-style iterator for QhullPoints, supporting forward and backward traversal.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts QhullPoints to a std::vector of QhullPoint.

methods.name: toQList
methods.description: Converts QhullPoints to a QList of QhullPoint (Qt-specific).

methods.name: at
methods.description: Returns the QhullPoint at a specified index.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns the last point in the array.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: constBegin
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: constEnd
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the end.

methods.name: coordinates
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the coordinate data.

methods.name: coordinateCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of coordinates.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality with another QhullPoints object.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality with another QhullPoints object.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a point is contained within the array.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a given point.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a subset of points starting at a given index.

methods.name: findNext
methods.description: Finds the next occurrence of a point.

methods.name: findPrevious
methods.description: Finds the previous occurrence of a point.
